display_information.name: Bureau
display_information.description: Ask your team's Bureau from Slack: check-ins, questions and work digests.
display_information.long_description: Bureau answers from your team's Bureau workspace: the latest check-ins from each teammate's AI, questions and answers, and the Team Work Board and digests built from GitHub, Vercel and other connected tools. Mention @Bureau in a channel, DM it, or use /bureau. Bureau only reads messages that mention it or are sent to it directly; it does not read channel history. Answers are built from Bureau data, without an AI model.

slash_commands.description: Ask Bureau: status, ask, questions, answer, board, digest
slash_commands.usage_hint: status jack | ask jack is the release on track? | digest weekly
